title: ITV / Channel expression strip
slide_intent: Compare the expressive range of channel identities within one network, because audiences need both a recognizable network and distinct programme destinations.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen network coherence without erasing channel personality.
demonstration: Five small channel-expression panels run horizontally on a dark field, showing repeated 1s, a pink dimensional 2, a blurred 3, green angular 4 and circles with Be.
practical_value: Compare the expressive range of channel identities within one network.
